stopLine: Do not guess an unavailable iPhone or Android model, merge credentials by model, overwrite a user rename, expand into external network channels, HTTPS hosting, or firewall changes, and do not substitute automated extraction tests for target-phone acceptance.
evidenceRefs: README defines first-scan pairing, durable trusted-device behavior, repeated-scan identity reuse, stable-origin migration, direct reopen, revocation, and model-first default device names with truthful fallback.

Structured user-confirmed decision LAN-TRUSTED-DEVICE-001 records confirmed and deferred scope, including the 2026-08-28 decision to use a reliably exposed phone model as the default name without guessing or identity merging.

The fixed 30-day server expiry remains removed, QR tickets are one-time, an already trusted browser refreshes or adopts its existing identity instead of creating a duplicate, phone model is display-only, generic names upgrade only on the same credential, and user renames are preserved.

The current branch candidate contains the persistent device registry, rolling browser session, model-first default naming, generic-name upgrade without overwriting user renames, local device management, revocation, repeated-scan reuse, origin-migration adoption, and tests.
Server and client typechecks passed on 2026-08-28 with model-first default naming and generic-name upgrade enabled.

Sixteen test files and forty-five tests passed, including Android User-Agent model extraction, Sec-CH-UA-Model preference, truthful iPhone fallback, generic-name upgrade, user-rename preservation, persistent trusted-device, revocation, repeated-scan reuse, one-time pairing tickets, and cross-origin identity adoption.
A temporary device authenticated before and after a production service restart, failed immediately after revocation, and was removed without changing the nine existing trusted devices on 2026-08-27.

The trusted-device count moved from 10 to 11 on first pairing, stayed 11 after rescanning the same QR, stayed 11 after a fresh-origin session adopted the stable-link identity, authenticated successfully, and returned to 10 after removing the temporary device on 2026-08-27.

The deployed portable package returned SM-S9280 from an Android Build User-Agent, 23127PN0CC from Sec-CH-UA-Model when the reduced User-Agent exposed only K, and the truthful fallback iPhone when no exact Apple model was available. Live trusted-device count stayed 2 and its file hash was unchanged.
